# fraud-prevention

> A fraud scoring engine with reason codes: velocity windows, account-takeover sequences, identity signals and promo-ring linking.

`fraudkit` scores a stream of account and payment events (signups, logins, credential changes, payouts, payments, promo redemptions) and returns a score, an action (`allow`, `review`, `deny`) and the reason codes that fired. Trailing count, sum and distinct-value windows, email and IP signals, an ordered account-takeover detector, and union-find linking over shared attributes are combined through YAML rules. There is no model to train. A labelled synthetic generator and an eval command are included.

Built and maintained by Art Akopian, CEO of Banrox (https://banrox.com).

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/fraud-prevention/blob/main/README.md): Install, event format, rules and examples.
- [docs/threat-model.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/fraud-prevention/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md): What the engine tries to catch, what it assumes, and where it is weak.
- [docs/tuning.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/fraud-prevention/blob/main/docs/tuning.md): How to adjust rules, weights and thresholds.
- [docs/benchmarks.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/fraud-prevention/blob/main/docs/benchmarks.md): Timeit measurements for the hot paths.
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/fraud-prevention/blob/main/SKILL.md): Agent skill for a first-pass fraud program review.

## Source

- [engine.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/fraud-prevention/blob/main/src/fraudkit/engine.py): Ties windows, signals, account-takeover, linking and rules into one score.
- [windows.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/fraud-prevention/blob/main/src/fraudkit/windows.py): Trailing count, sum and distinct-value windows.
- [signals.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/fraud-prevention/blob/main/src/fraudkit/signals.py): Email normalisation, disposable and plus-tag checks, IP ranges.
- [ato.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/fraud-prevention/blob/main/src/fraudkit/ato.py): New device, then credential change, then payout or withdrawal.
- [linking.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/fraud-prevention/blob/main/src/fraudkit/linking.py): Union-find over accounts and shared attributes.
- [rules.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/fraud-prevention/blob/main/src/fraudkit/rules.py): YAML rule loading and validation.
- [events.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/fraud-prevention/blob/main/src/fraudkit/events.py): Event parsing, bounds and deduplication.
- [synth.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/fraud-prevention/blob/main/src/fraudkit/synth.py): Labelled synthetic event generator.
- [cli.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/fraud-prevention/blob/main/src/fraudkit/cli.py): `score`, `synth`, `eval` and `validate` commands.
